title: Number of Activity Queue entries displayed in side panel does not match filtered count
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior If there are entries in the activity queue then the number of entries is displayed next to the Activity Queue selector in the side panel. In v4, if the filter was changed to exclude unknown series and some entries were filtered out then this number would change to reflect that. In v5 the number remains as the unfiltered count. ### Expected Behavior The count of entries in the activity queue matches the filter used. ### Steps To Reproduce Requires entries in the activity queue - eg remove a show which still has episodes in the download client. Set filter to "Exclude Unknown Series Items" Those entries disappear from the queue The count remains unchanged ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Windows - Sonarr: 5.0.0.2569 - Docker Install: No - Using Reverse Proxy: No - Browser: Brave - Database: Standard ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|Http|Req: 7009 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/queue?page=1&pageSize=20&sortKey=time&sortDirection=descending (from 192.168.1.224 Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36) 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|Http|Req: 7010 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/series (from 192.168.1.224 Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36) 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|Http|Req: 7011 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/settings/ui (from 192.168.1.224 Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36) 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|Http|Res: 7009 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/queue?page=1&pageSize=20&sortKey=time&sortDirection=descending: 200.OK (14 ms) 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|ConfigService|Using default config value for 'timezone' defaultValue:'' 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|ConfigService|Using default config value for 'showrelativedates' defaultValue:'True' 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|ConfigService|Using default config value for 'uilanguage' defaultValue:'1' 2026-10-14 09:09:46.9|Trace|Http|Res: 7011 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/settings/ui: 200.OK (5 ms) 2026-10-14 09:09:47.3|Trace|Http|Res: 7010 [GET] /sonarr/api/v5/series: 200.OK (391 ms) ### Anything else
